name: Book Employee with Spouse — Spouse DOB Future Date
goal: User tries to enter a future date as spouse DOB; bot rejects and user corrects it.
constraints: First DOB input is a future date; second input is valid and accepted.

phases.description: User selects 'Employee with Spouse' and provides spouse name.
User enters future date as spouse DOB.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot replies with 'Date of birth cannot be today or a future date. Only spouses aged 18 or above are eligible. Please enter a valid date of birth.'
Bot confirms booking and displays selected clinic name.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
